mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflationary spike above 305 in CPIAUCSL triggers investor concerns about future rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative within 5 trading days of the CPIAUCSL crossing above 305, or remain negative for less than 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (industrial production) signals robust economic growth, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase by >5% over the prior month
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or HOUST does not increase by >5% in the prior month, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS rates reduces discount rates for future cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, FEDFUNDS decline does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in UNRATE above 3.6% signals weakening labor market conditions, prompting investors to anticipate higher unemployment and reduced corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses above 3.6% but 5-day forward returns remain non-negative, or the increase is not sustained for at least 3 days post-trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A convergence of rising PAYEMS (employment) and falling UNRATE (unemployment) indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >2% and UNRATE decreases by >0.1% in the same month
failure_condition: Either PAYEMS does not increase by >2% or UNRATE does not decrease by >0.1% in the same month, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS rates below 4.5% over 60 trading days reduces discount rates for future cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS remains below 4.5% for 60 trading days
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS stays below 4.5% for 60 days but 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) indices signals robust economic growth, reducing uncertainty and lifting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase by >5% over the prior month
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or INDPRO does not increase by >5% in the prior month, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p < 0.05).
